title: Instructions for recreating the elPrep 4.0.0 WES benchmarks
author: Charlotte Herzeel
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.wzxff7n

steps.title: Install elPrep 4.0.1
steps.instruction: Install the elPrep binary distribution into the working directory.

substeps.instruction: Download the elPrep binary distribution from https://github.com/ExaScience/elprep/releases/download/v4.0.1/elprep-v4.0.1.tar.gz
Move the archive: mv elprep-v4.0.1.tar.gz elprep-v4.0.1

steps.title: Download Required Data
steps.instruction: Acquire the necessary FASTQ, BED, reference, and variant files.

substeps.instruction: Download GIAB whole-exome NA12878 FASTQ and BED files: ftp://ftp-trace.ncbi.nih.gov/giab/ftp/data/NA12878/Garvan_NA12878_HG001_HiSeq_Exome/NIST7035_TAAGGCGA_L001_R1_001.fasq.gz, ftp://ftp-trace.ncbi.nih.gov/giab/ftp/data/NA12878/Garvan_NA12878_HG001_HiSeq_Exome/NIST7035_TAAGGCGA_L001_R2_001.fastq.gz, and ftp://ftp-trace.ncbi.nih.gov/giab/ftp/data/NA12878/Garvan_NA12878_HG001_HiSeq_Exome/nexterarapidcapture_expandedexome_targetedregions.bed.gz

steps.title: Create Reference Index
steps.instruction: Generate the BWA index for the reference genome.

steps.title: Align FASTQ Files
steps.instruction: Align FASTQ files to create a BAM file using BWA mem and elPrep.

substeps.instruction: Run: bwa-0.7.17/bwa mem -t 72 -R '@RG\tID:Group1\tLB:lib1\tPL:illumina\tSM:sample1' ucsc.hg19.fasta.gz NIST7035_TAAGGCGA_L001_R1_001.fastq.gz NIST7035_TAAGGCGA_L001_R2_001.fastq.gz | elprep /dev/stdin NA12878.bam (Approx. 5 minutes)

steps.title: Create hg19 elfasta File
steps.instruction: Convert the reference fasta to elPrep-specific elfasta format.

substeps.instruction: Convert: elprep fasta-to-elfasta hg19.fasta ucsc.hg19.elfasta (Approx. 1 minute)

steps.title: Create elsites Files
steps.instruction: Convert VCF files to elPrep-specific elsites format.

substeps.instruction: Process dbsnp: gunzip dbsnp_138.hg19.vcf.gz then elprep vcf-to-elsites dbsnp_138.hg19.vcf dbsnp_138.hg19.elsites (Approx. 1 minute)

Process Mills/1000G: gunzip Mills_and_1000G_gold_standard.indels.hg19.sites.vcf.gz then elprep vcf-to-elsites Mills_and_1000G_gold_standard.indels.hg19.sites.vcf Mills_and_1000G_gold_standard.indels.hg19.elsites (Approx. 10 seconds)

steps.title: Prepare BED File
steps.instruction: Decompress the captured regions BED file.

steps.title: Run elPrep Filter Mode
steps.instruction: Execute the pipeline using the in-memory filter mode (requires 80 GB RAM).

substeps.instruction: Run: elprep filter NA12878.bam NA12878.filter.bam --mark-duplicates --mark-optical-duplicates NA12878.filter.metrics --sorting-order coordinate --bqsr NA12878.filter.recal --known-sites Mills_and_1000G_gold_standard.indels.hg19.elsites,dbsnp_138.hg19.elsites --bqsr-reference ucsc.hg19.elfasta --filter-non-overlapping-reads nexterarapidcapture_expandedexome_targetedregions.bed (Approx. 5 minutes)

steps.title: Run elPrep SFM Mode
steps.instruction: Execute the pipeline using the split-filter-merge (sfm) mode (requires 22 GB RAM).

substeps.instruction: Run: elprep sfm NA12878.bam NA12878.sfm.bam --mark-duplicates --mark-optical-duplicates NA12878.sfm.metrics --sorting-order coordinate --bqsr NA12878.sfm.recal --known-sites Mills_and_1000G_gold_standard.indels.hg19.elsites,dbsnp_138.hg19.elsites --bqsr-reference ucsc.hg19.elfasta --filter-non-overlapping-reads nexterarapidcapture_expandedexome_targetedregions.bed (Approx. 11 minutes)

steps.title: Install SAMtools 1.9
steps.instruction: Compile SAMtools from source for optional statistics.

steps.title: Generate Statistics
steps.instruction: Index the BAM file and generate flag statistics.
